observations.note: Company announcement 'Applied Compute hits $100M run rate and raises $350M' (dated Nov 2, 2026), with the round at a $3.25B valuation led by Elad Gil. Search summaries of the post say the company went 'from zero to a $100 million run rate in less than 18 months'; SiliconANGLE (Nov 3, https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/03/ai-cloud-startup-applied-compute-raises-350m-after-reaching-key-revenue-milestone/) says its 'annualized recurring revenue has passed $100 million' and that the startup 'announced the deal on Monday' (Nov 2). A threshold. No period end date is given, so this is dated to the Nov 2 announcement. Revenue type (gross/net/contracted) not stated, so no basis is set. Company-reported, unaudited. Search-result snippets only; neither page was read (WebFetch was stopped after ENOTFOUND on techcrunch.com and blog.mean.ceo).
